forms.name: 跨部门灾备演练计划
forms.description: 记录演练范围、参与部门、时间窗口、业务影响与恢复目标，供分公司初审、部门并行审批及总公司会签。
forms.configDefinition: {"schemaVersion":1,"title":"跨部门灾备演练计划","description":"用于评估演练影响并协调各参与部门的审批计划。","fields":[{"name":"drillName","label":"演练名称","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":120,"colSpan":24},{"name":"branchName","label":"分公司","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":100,"colSpan":12},{"name":"initiatingDepartment","label":"发起部门","type":"DEPT","required":true,"colSpan":12},{"name":"initiator","label":"演练负责人","type":"USER","required":true,"colSpan":12},{"name":"drillCategory","label":"演练类型","type":"MULTISELECT","required":true,"source":"custom","options":[{"key":"power","value":"供电切换"},{"key":"network","value":"网络切换"},{"key":"database","value":"数据库恢复"},{"key":"full_site","value":"机房级演练"}],"colSpan":12},{"name":"severity","label":"风险等级","type":"MULTISELECT","required":true,"source":"custom","options":[{"key":"low","value":"低"},{"key":"medium","value":"中"},{"key":"high","value":"高"}],"colSpan":12},{"name":"participatingDepartments","label":"参与部门","type":"DEPT","required":true,"multiple":true,"colSpan":24},{"name":"targetSites","label":"目标机房与系统","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":2000,"colSpan":24},{"name":"plannedStart","label":"计划开始时间","type":"DATE","required":true,"format":"datetime","colSpan":12},{"name":"plannedEnd","label":"计划结束时间","type":"DATE","required":true,"format":"datetime","colSpan":12},{"name":"maintenanceWindowMinutes","label":"预计维护窗口（分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":120,"colSpan":8},{"name":"recoveryTargetMinutes","label":"恢复目标 RTO（分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":30,"colSpan":8},{"name":"dataLossTargetMinutes","label":"数据恢复点 RPO（分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":5,"colSpan":8},{"name":"businessImpact","label":"业务影响评估","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":3000,"colSpan":24},{"name":"rollbackPlan","label":"回退与恢复方案","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":3000,"colSpan":24},{"name":"successCriteria","label":"演练成功标准","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":2000,"colSpan":24},{"name":"stakeholderNotes","label":"相关方补充说明","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":2000,"colSpan":24}]}

forms.name: 校园出入口异常事件记录
forms.description: 汇总闸机流量、校内活动、公开活动检索和处置判断，形成可追溯的分级处置记录。
forms.configDefinition: {"schemaVersion":1,"title":"校园出入口异常事件记录","description":"记录事件事实和判级依据，支持 P1 关注处置与 P0 应急升级。","fields":[{"name":"campusName","label":"校区","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":100,"colSpan":12},{"name":"gateCode","label":"出入口编号","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":80,"colSpan":12},{"name":"eventAt","label":"异常发生时间","type":"DATE","required":true,"format":"datetime","colSpan":12},{"name":"observationWindowMinutes","label":"统计窗口（分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":15,"colSpan":12},{"name":"inboundObserved","label":"窗口内入校人数","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"colSpan":6},{"name":"inboundBaseline","label":"入校常态基线","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"colSpan":6},{"name":"outboundObserved","label":"窗口内离校人数","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"colSpan":6},{"name":"outboundBaseline","label":"离校常态基线","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"colSpan":6},{"name":"weatherAndSiteContext","label":"天气与现场情况","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":1200,"colSpan":24},{"name":"internalEventReferences","label":"校内活动与近期流程检索摘要","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"publicEventSummary","label":"公开活动与特殊日期检索摘要","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"activityAssessment","label":"活动关联结论（SPECIAL / UNEXPLAINED）","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":32,"colSpan":12},{"name":"assessmentRationale","label":"判定依据与不确定项","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"recommendedPriority","label":"建议处置级别（P1 / P0）","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":16,"colSpan":12},{"name":"assignedOwner","label":"处置负责人","type":"USER","required":true,"colSpan":12},{"name":"responseDueAt","label":"首次响应时限","type":"DATE","required":true,"format":"datetime","colSpan":12},{"name":"resolutionSummary","label":"现场处置与结案摘要","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"evidenceFiles","label":"现场证据","type":"ATTACHMENT","required":false,"colSpan":24}]}

forms.name: MES 设备温度偏离研判记录
forms.description: 记录设备温度序列、工艺背景、阈值与升温速率，区分快速异常、正常加料波动和紧急停机级别。
forms.configDefinition: {"schemaVersion":1,"title":"MES 设备温度偏离研判记录","description":"阈值和速率参数随记录显式留痕；本表单不直接向设备下发控制命令。","fields":[{"name":"facility","label":"厂区","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":100,"colSpan":12},{"name":"productionLine","label":"生产线","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":100,"colSpan":12},{"name":"equipmentCode","label":"设备编号","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":100,"colSpan":12},{"name":"batchNumber","label":"生产批次","type":"TEXT","required":false,"length":100,"colSpan":12},{"name":"readingAt","label":"测温时间","type":"DATE","required":true,"format":"datetime","colSpan":12},{"name":"currentTemperature","label":"当前温度（℃）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"colSpan":12},{"name":"normalBaseline","label":"常温参考（℃）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":75,"colSpan":6},{"name":"alertThreshold","label":"告警阈值（℃）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":80,"colSpan":6},{"name":"stopThreshold","label":"停机阈值（℃）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":85,"colSpan":6},{"name":"riseRatePerMinute","label":"升温速率（℃/分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"colSpan":6},{"name":"rapidRiseThreshold","label":"快速升温判定值（℃/分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":2.0,"colSpan":12},{"name":"assessmentWindowMinutes","label":"研判窗口（分钟）","type":"NUMBER","required":true,"defaultValue":5,"colSpan":12},{"name":"materialAdditionInProgress","label":"是否处于人工加料阶段","type":"BOOL","required":true,"defaultValue":false,"colSpan":12},{"name":"calibrationStatus","label":"传感器校准状态","type":"TEXT","required":false,"length":80,"colSpan":12},{"name":"temperatureSequenceSummary","label":"温度序列与数据质量说明","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"agentKnowledgeEvidence","label":"知识样本命中与研判依据","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"assessmentConclusion","label":"研判结论（NORMAL / RAPID_RISE / EMERGENCY）","type":"TEXT","required":true,"length":32,"colSpan":12},{"name":"recommendedAction","label":"建议处置与安全措施","type":"TEXT","required":true,"multiline":true,"length":2400,"colSpan":24},{"name":"responsibleOwner","label":"当班负责人","type":"USER","required":true,"colSpan":12},{"name":"reviewNotes","label":"复核与交接记录","type":"TEXT","required":false,"multiline":true,"length":1800,"colSpan":24}]}
